code.description: Attribute identifier, using ASCII letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

name.description:
Human-readable attribute name. `{{…}}` references resolve from the
workspace lexicon.

value_schema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for scalar values, written as a YAML mapping.

default_value.description:
Value stored in the default context when a record is created.
Not supported for relationships and files.

target_blueprint_code.description: Blueprint that relationship targets must use.

cardinality.description: How many targets one source may link to.

target_cardinality.description: How many sources may link to one target.

tags.description:
Free-form metadata. `hidden`, `hidden:form`, `hidden:detail`,
`hidden:explorer`, and `hidden:metadata` hide the attribute from default UI.

context_fallback.description:
Missing values in a non-default context: `default` inherits from the
nearest ancestor context; `none` leaves the attribute absent.

context_editable.description: Contexts that accept writes: `all`, or only the `default` context.

readonly.description: Preview-only in the Attricat web app. API writes remain allowed.

facetable.description:
Offer the attribute as an Explorer filter. Takes effect together with
`searchable`, which lets search filters name the attribute.

title: Attricat reusable attribute definition
description: A workspace attribute that record blueprints can attach by reference.
